While most operators have symbols for names (e.g. +, or ==), there are also a number of operators that are keywords (e.g. new, delete, and throw).Author’s noteFor reasons that will become clear when we discuss operators in more detail, for operators that are symbols, it is common to append the operator’s symbol to the word operator.For example, the plus operator would be written operator+, and the extraction operator would be written operator>>.
source_suffix: Few people know what this word means, so don’t drop it in a conversation and expect anybody to have any idea what you’re talking about. Operators in C++ come in four different arities:Unary operators act on one operand. An example of a unary operator is the - operator.
